}}'''Baellin''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Degalle]] sept of the [[Shiande]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Janwin}}

==History==
Baellin is the Wise One of [[Nine Stones Hold]], a settlement belonging to the Shiande Aiel of the [[Degalle]] sept. She is thus the Wise One in service to [[Janwin]], the [[clan chief]] of the Shiande.
